remarks: Welcome to 1385 Washington Blvd #5, a spacious 3,100-square-foot townhouse built in 2022 and ideally located in downtown Stamford. This beautifully designed residence offers 3 bedrooms, each with its own en-suite bath, plus an additional powder room. A generous open layout, abundant large windows, private entrance, balcony, and private two-car garage create a bright and comfortable living experience. Just 4 minutes from the Stamford Metro-North station, less than one hour from NYC, and close to restaurants, shopping, theaters, UCONN Stamford, and everything downtown has to offer.
